description: If \(N\) is \(\omega\)-saturated, every finite partial elementary map \(f:A\to B\) from \(M\) to \(N\) extends at each \(a\in M\) to a finite partial elementary bijection \(f^{\prime}:A\cup\{a\}\to B\cup\{b\}\) retaining all old values and satisfying \(f^{\prime}(a)=b\); if \(a\notin A\), then \(b\notin B\).
